notes: All callees cited by address are members of this pack (0087DC00, 0087DD50, 0087E470, 0087E680, 0087E790, 0087E880, 0087EBF0). 0087DD50: the call to 0087E470 receives rcx = rcx because 0087E790 never writes rcx. 0087DFA0: four of its six tables are addressed as image base + offset without a resolved address in the listing, so they are written that way, not as 8-digit addresses. 0087E680: v[0] is never written; entries with len 0 skip the call. Doubts: 0087DD50 and 0087E470 are dense and stated at structure level; worth a second read of the heap index bookkeeping (q starts at 0x23D, decremented before each store).
